title: helianthus angustifolius subsp. ciliaris
intro: Helianthus angustifolius subsp. ciliaris, commonly known as Narrow-leafed Sneezeweed, is a plant species that belongs to the sunflower family. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Narrow-leafed Sneezeweed have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antibacterial activities, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
